variants.headline: Home world raises its demands
variants.sub: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased.
variants.body:
The home world has raised what it demands of the colony. The increase puts the relationship between distant authority and local obligation in focus. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the higher demand from any unreported account of its size, form or practical enforcement.

When more is demanded of a colony, working people have reason to ask who is expected to carry the burden. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A larger claim on the colony
variants.sub: The home world is demanding more from {colony}.
variants.body:
A demand made at a distance still concerns the people expected to meet it. The home world is asking more of {colony}. In assessing {target}, the question is how authority and obligation should be judged, without assuming the particular terms that this report does not supply.

When more is demanded of a colony, working people have reason to ask who is expected to carry the burden. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Distant authority asks for more
variants.sub: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony.
variants.body:
The colony faces increased demands from the home world. That change is the news; the extent of its burden is not specified here. A fair account of {target} should examine the relationship it represents without fabricating a quantity, a deadline or a reason for the increase.

When more is demanded of a colony, working people have reason to ask who is expected to carry the burden. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
